Hi Dirk —

Thanks for the detail and the attachment. Short answers up front, then specifics & next steps:

- Feature bundling: we can grandfather routing rules and existing key-cache behaviour for up to 90 days, but advanced continuous-batching (the per-token optimization) is only available on Standard+ and would be removed on day one.
- Downgrade credits: for annual prepay we offer a pro-rated account credit for the unused portion of the higher-tier commitment; we dont do cash refunds. For a mid-term swap we can combine the pro-rate with a one-time transition credit (typically 10-15%) depending on ARR and contract length.

Options I recommend:
1) Soft downgrade (recommended): move to Standard immediately but grandfather routing & cache for 60 days, issue pro-rated credit plus a 10% transition credit. 60 days minimizes operational risk for you.
2) Full downgrade with short grace: move immediately and grandfather only 30 days, pro-rate credit only (no transition credit).
3) Delayed downgrade: keep Standard+ until end-of-term, then switch on renewal with no pro-rates.

I've looped Marcus on commercial approval and Monica for the migration runbook. If you want a firmer offer I can ask Marcus to approve a 15% transition credit for an existing annual commitment > $150k.

Next steps:
- Tell me which option you prefer and the target effective date.
- If you want the 15% approval please confirm ARR band.
- Ill send a short amendment + DocuSign link for sign-off.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call today if it helps — slots at 11:30 or 14:30 PT.

Best,
